script.text: A man at the bus stop has twelve seconds left. Sam grabs his collar and pulls. A truck runs the red light. His timer spins. Twelve seconds becomes forty-one years.
What if you could see how long everyone has left?
Green means decades. Orange means years. Red means hurry. You can't see your own. Not in a mirror.
Then one morning, Lily's number drops. Eighty-one years, down to two days. Saturday, two forty. Her birthday. Forty-eight hours.
